clues.text: A village about seven miles from Jerusalem, where two disciples were walking on the day the tomb was found empty.
After Jesus vanished from their table in this village, two disciples asked each other if their hearts had not been burning.
One of the two disciples walking to this village after the crucifixion was a man named Cleopas.
On the walk to this village, Jesus explained what Moses and all the Prophets had written about Himself.
Nearing this village, Jesus acted as if going farther, but two disciples begged Him to stay since evening was near.
At a table in this village, Jesus blessed and broke bread, and two disciples suddenly knew who He was.
Leaving this village that very hour, two disciples hurried back to Jerusalem and found the Eleven gathered together.
